Consider the graph of the function $f(x),$ shown above. It consists of two line segments, an arc of a quarter-circle centered at $(0,0)$ with radius $1$, and an arc of a quarter-circle centered at $(3,0)$ with radius $3.$ Find the value of ${\int }_{-2}^{6}f(x)\,\text{d}x.$
